requirements.description: User prefers properties near green spaces. Threshold set at the 75th percentile (74.26), rounded to 74, for the 'near green spaces' preference.

The user explicitly requires a gross floor area of at least 600 sqm.

output.explanation: Filters ESTATES to school-type properties (Attività scolastiche) with surface_area of at least 600 sqm, energy class A1 through D, and green score of at least 74. Keeps only properties within 3.0 km of the given coordinates (45.0677551, 7.6824892) using the latitude/longitude columns, and orders results by distance from that point. The capacity-for-45-people requirement is not in the extracted requirements, so it is not applied.
